study_note: Single-seed vanilla XQC Humanoid Walk state baseline at seed 55 for one million agent decisions and two million raw control frames. This keeps XQC's UTD-two learner, 5k-decision warmup, and evaluation after decision one and every 50k decisions, producing 21 evaluation rows. It extends the released 500k-decision budget solely to compare against the one-million-decision AMBI-XQC screen in the same W&B group; it is not a paper reproduction. Portable best/latest checkpoints are published every 100k decisions. Exact trainer resume is not supported.
